check_box.name: lightning_enabled_check
check_box.label: Lightning
check_box.tool_tip: Whether this sky has lightning at all. Stable and Breezy skies never strike even with this on - there is nothing unstable enough in them to discharge.

check_box.name: lightning_charge_check
check_box.label: Gathering charge before a strike
check_box.tool_tip: Crackle, sparks and corona gathering in the air where a strike is about to land, seconds before it does. Nothing in real weather announces a strike; this is for skies that are not trying to be real. On by default.

check_box.name: lightning_sparks_check
check_box.label: Sparks at the impact
check_box.tool_tip: Sparks thrown outward where a cloud-to-ground strike lands. On by default.

text.name: lightning_color_label
text.tool_tip: The glow around the channel - what gives lightning its colour. The core stays white unless Core Whiteness is wound down.

color_swatch.tool_tip: The glow around the channel - what gives lightning its colour. The core stays white unless Core Whiteness is wound down.
color_swatch.name: lightning_color

button.name: lightning_color_keyframe_button
button.tool_tip: Add or remove a keyframe at the current preview time

text.name: lightning_core_white_label
text.tool_tip: How white the channel core stays against the bolt colour. 1 is a white-hot channel in a coloured glow, as in nature; 0 colours the bolt all the way through.

slider.name: lightning_core_white_slider
slider.tool_tip: How white the channel core stays against the bolt colour. 1 is a white-hot channel in a coloured glow, as in nature; 0 colours the bolt all the way through.

spinner.name: lightning_core_white_value_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: How white the channel core stays against the bolt colour. 1 is a white-hot channel in a coloured glow, as in nature; 0 colours the bolt all the way through.

button.name: lightning_core_white_keyframe_button
button.tool_tip: Add or remove a keyframe at the current preview time

check_box.name: lightning_auto_check
check_box.label: Lightning Auto
check_box.tool_tip: Derive lightning intensity from convection; uncheck to author it directly. Stable and Breezy skies never strike either way

text.name: lightning_intensity_label
text.tool_tip: Strike cadence with Auto off: a whisper near zero is about a strike a minute, full matches a Severe sky's 2 to 5 seconds. An override is an order, so this ignores the moisture gate auto mode obeys - though the temperature season still stretches the intervals
